summary: Analyzed all 9* non-food packaged items used as BOM components or customization option values across 5 brands (Hanu Poke, Bellies, Limesalt, El Diez, Yasas) for FOR_SALE menu items. Excluded 26 label-type items. Paired 10 container+lid combinations. Found 52 relevant 9* items organized into containers, bags, sleeves, and other packaging. HSide Concept not found in Cookbook.
questions: Which 9* packaging items are reusable across Wonder Create items?
learned: 4 commissary brands share nearly identical packaging sets; El Diez has independent menus
2oz Souffle Cup (9002138) is the most-used non-food item (28-166 menu items/brand)
Souffle Cups are exclusively from customization options, not direct BOM
32oz and 48oz Pulp Bowls share 3 lid types
thinking: This analysis helps Wonder Create team avoid creating duplicate non-food items when onboarding new menu items
